answer: An oasis market at the edge of an orchard stays honest when every trader must publish a peer-reviewed audit before trading. The first newcomer publishes 1 audit, the tenth publishes 10, and the twentieth publishes 20, each checked by a different auditor and never reusable for another name. A farmer of fakes faces a bill that climbs with every identity: 20 fakes demand 210 audits, and one velvet-smooth report cannot cover twenty strangers, since each audit is tied to one identity and read line by line. Like tending separate trees, every extra name adds another audit to write and defend.
